Notice that if M dx + N dy + P dz = dƒ on D, then F = Mi + Nj + Pk is the gra- dient field of ƒ on D. Conversely, if F = ∇ƒ, then the form M dx + N dy + P dz is exact. The test for the form’s being exact is therefore the same as the test for F being conservative.
